answer: Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond of tokens to register, and peers attest only after verifying a unique proof-of-personhood anchored to that bond. An attacker who tries to wander in with thousands of fake identities must post collateral for each, and slashing burns it on any disputed attestation, so the cost of a convincing swarm grows with the square of its size. Like a lantern hung on shale cliffs, the bond marks real ground; forging a crowd means paying full price for every shadow. Operator sa0013 applies this at D1uBU5ZT75.
